conventions.locator: "page N" = 1-based PDF page (form-feed page in text/*.txt; === PAGE N === in enrich/txt; page image N for the OCR'd judgment). "line N" = 1-based index of the non-empty line in the doc's extracted .txt (more/articles/<id>.txt, more/docs/<id>.txt, enrich/txt/<id>.txt, or text/<id>.txt for HTML regulator releases).
conventions.quotes: Verbatim substrings after whitespace normalisation. For the scanned Malaysian judgments the quote is transcribed from the page image; the OCR text (enrich/ocr/...) may differ by OCR noise; "match" records the fuzzy score.
conventions.docs: New downloads listed in enrich/dl_log.jsonl (url, sha256, bytes). OCR of existing scanned PDFs in enrich/ocr/.

existing_claims_review.text: Singapore's MAS shut BSI Bank's Singapore operation for serious anti-money-laundering breaches and referred six staff, including Yeo Jiawei, to prosecutors.

existing_claims_review.text: Swiss regulator FINMA found BSI seriously breached money-laundering rules in its 1MDB business and ordered it to give up CHF 95 million in profits.

existing_claims_review.text: MAS closed Falcon Private Bank's Singapore branch and fined DBS and UBS over 1MDB-related fund flows.

existing_claims_review.text: Jho Low was the beneficial owner of Good Star Limited, the company that received $1.03 billion meant for the PetroSaudi joint venture.

existing_claims_review.text: Aabar-BVI sent $238 million to Riza Aziz's Red Granite Capital, money that helped fund Red Granite Pictures and "The Wolf of Wall Street".

existing_claims_review.text: Khadem al-Qubaisi received $472.75 million of 2012 bond money through the Blackstone account.

existing_claims_review.basis: Single civil complaint; no judgment in the set (2018-19 recovery/sale records not obtained).

existing_claims_review.text: 1MDB general counsel Jasmine Loo received 1MDB money and used $3.1 million of it to buy a London property.
existing_claims_review.basis: Two DOJ complaints; Loo testified as a prosecution witness in the Najib trial (2025 grounds) but no finding on the London flat found.

existing_claims_review.text: 1MDB officials made the $700 million transfer of September 2009 to PetroSaudi as settlement of amounts the joint venture owed it.

existing_claims_review.text: The $681 million that reached Malaysian Official 1's account was a personal donation from the Saudi royal family.
existing_claims_review.basis: Three Malaysian judicial decisions reject the donation story (cl-02).

existing_claims_review.text: The $1.367 billion 1MDB paid to Aabar-BVI in 2012 was a refundable deposit held as collateral for IPIC's guarantee.
existing_claims_review.basis: Still conflicting accounts within DOJ complaint; Malaysian court uses "purportedly as a security deposit". No adjudication found.

existing_claims_review.text: Aabar Investments PJS Limited (BVI) was owned by IPIC's subsidiary Aabar.

existing_claims_review.text: Husseiny invested his own personal money in Red Granite Pictures.
